description: List every asset in the estate with its type and value. Your Estate Context already lists the assets, so call this only when you need the full set fresh (e.g. right after creating or updating one) or the context block was truncated. For one asset's linked tasks, use get_asset_detail instead.

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

name: get_assets
